dct_description_sm: Contained within the Atlas of Canada's Reference Map Series, 1961 to 2010, is a map that shows international boundaries (and their status) current to January 2000. By means of capital type (for sovereign country names) and upper-lower type (for dependencies), the map indicates the status of all parts of the World. Places and geographical features within countries use local versions of names. However, a table on the map gives the commonly-used versions of some of these names. Populated places are shown in three size classes. The map has a table giving air distances between major cities and a table listing two-letter abbreviations for selected countries.
